item.title: Housing sale prices hit a record high for Alabama in 2025
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala. (WDHN) - Falling interest rates and strong employment is the reason for increased home sales and median prices across Alabama during 2025, according to the 2025 Annual Alabama Economic and Real Estate Report. There were 71,485 home sales in the Yellowhammer state in 2025, which is representing an increase of 3.9% since 2024. [...]

item.title: Geneva police will auction off unclaimed vehicles in March

item.title: Road closure for electric maintenance Wednesday
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- There will be road closures near the 300 block of Pinetree Drive in Dothan on February 4 from 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Roads will be closed for electric system maintenance by the city. Signs, cones and personnel will be present to direct motorists and homeowners in the area.
